notes.title: The big battle butt-sumo action game "Nyaaaanvy" will be animation!
notes.notes:
Nyaaaanvy, the action game in which the "self-proclaimed" feline creatures, "Nyanvy", use their wiggly bodies to wrestle each other's butts, is now available as a terrestrial anime!
Nyaaaanvy", a hot indie game that has received "very positive reviews" on Steam and has been enjoyed by many people including influencers, will be released on February 22, 2024 (Cat's Day) for the Switch, and is expected to gain even more popularity. Please enjoy the animation of the slightly mysterious world of "Nyanvy," which is being further enhanced by a cast of gorgeous voice actors.

notes.title: 【2024.03.15　Patch Note】
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Nyaaaanvy".

We have made the following changes/updates.

＜Shrine Stage
Removed unnecessary collision (hit detection) at the bottom of the stairs.

＜Chapter 5 - Laboratory Search Stage
The effect around the lock after checking the cage has been changed to disappear. The passage is now blocked after the first battle with the penguin.

 <Customization
Fixed the problem that the image of My Set is blacked out in some materials Fixed the cursor can be moved to the right when selecting the color category in the left column Fixed the weight of some customizations Fixed the UI of random customizations

 <Casual Match
 Shortened the time to start Casual Match.

<Local Match
 Fixed UI shrinking when displaying warning text.

 <UI> Fixed some images for stage selection.
 Fixed some images in stage selection Shortened the time to display the damage value when an attack hit.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: 【Notice】Official Release
notes.notes:
We have officially released the game!
Thank you for playing since early access.
We look forward to your continued support.

notes.title: Patch note 0.3.0
notes.notes:
The event stage "Halloween Night" has been added.
Many Halloween customizations have been added.
An item exchange system has been added along with the event.
The number of My Sets saved has been increased.
The number of stages selected for rate competitions has been increased.
Stick input for selecting emotes has been adjusted.
Added simple emotes for local matches.
The behavior of Nyambi when attacking has been adjusted. (including extension and contraction).
Judgment and effects of uppercut attacks have been adjusted.
Stamina recovery speed during normal play has been adjusted to be faster.
Other minor changes.

notes.title: Patch note 0.2.4

Fixed a problem in which Survival Mode results were not reflected in the online ranking.
The number of accessory categories in the customization has been increased and two accessories can now be attached at the same time.

Other minor changes

notes.title: Patch note 0.2.3
notes.notes:
Some backstage stages have been added.
The difficulty of the CPU can now be selected.
The number of CPUs in online matches has been increased to allow one player to play alone.
It is now possible to enter a room during a match, except at certain times.
The effect duration of energy drinks has been shortened and a stamina consumption reduction effect has been added.

Graphic improvements, such as textures, etc.
Many other minor changes

notes.title: Patch note 0.2.2
notes.notes:
Several elements have been added to the Local mode.
Arcade mode now has courses of different difficulty levels, and Survival mode now has a BAGOMA stage.
Some backstage levels are now selectable.
The range of giant bombs has been made visible.
Other minor changes

notes.title: Patch note 0.2.1
notes.notes:
New customization items are added.
A brightness setting was added to the options.
My Set Nyanvy can now be selected in local matches.
Fixed a crash that occurred mainly in the "Fish Heaven" stage.
Variable FPS has been added to greatly reduce lag caused by PC specs.
This reduces the stretchy and rampant Nyanvy that occurs mainly in online play.
Please try it out if you have had difficulty playing against other players due to lag in the past.

We have made a major balance adjustment this time.
Changed the behavior of attack moves.
Changed hit judges
Changed hit judges for bombs, etc.
The above changes are expected to alleviate the severe difficulty of hitting the target.
Fixing the critical hit when the blast hits the face.
The cursor changes color as the amount of damage accumulates.
The cursor becomes darker as it approaches 100% and blinks when it exceeds 100%.
UI adjustments (some work in progress)
Other minor fixes

notes.title: About Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by unstable multiplayer.

If you can't enter a rated match, can't find a session, or can't create a room
Sometimes logging back into Steam will improve the situation. Please try restarting the app and re-logging in to Steam if you think something is wrong.

Sometimes I get blown up by an unknown hit point during multiplayer.
Due to CPU load, you may be out of online sync.
Disabling fog and reducing shadow quality in the options may improve this.

No matching in rate matches
There are still a few people in the game, but the system is designed to prevent matching with players who are incompatible with each other.
Restarting the app may stabilize the situation.

We will try to optimize the system, so please keep us posted.
